title: Lidarr Release Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player/achievements (`steam:player`), Sonarr/Radarr events (`sonarr:event`).
app: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, and *arr stack (Sonarr/Radarr) APIs and webhooks via HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lidarr:release
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(artist_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Lidarr release events land each day and how many distinct artist values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Lidarr release records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct artist values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It predicts how much Lidarr release activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
